# Di Dee Designers

> Saree pre-pleating, box folding and draping service in Tiruppur, Tamil Nadu, India. We prepare the customer's own saree; we do not sell sarees.

## Services and prices (INR)
- Pressed pleats (box folding): Rs 250
- Semi-fluffy pleats: Rs 300
- Full-fluffy pleats with hanger: Rs 400
- Silk and bridal saree care, pleating to your style, family and bulk orders, express preparation (subject to availability)
- Scheduled pickup and doorstep delivery in Tiruppur, Avinashi and Erode

## Contact

- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 90030 37820
